preconditions.expression: all(61 < int(line.strip()) < 10**6 and int(line.strip()) % 2 == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '0')
preconditions.description: Every input line (except the terminating '0') is an odd integer strictly between 61 and 10^6.
The input ends with a line containing exactly '0'.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.strip().splitlines()[i].strip() == '0 0 0' or (all(int(p) > 1 and all(int(p) % d != 0 for d in range(2, int(int(p)**0.5) + 1)) for p in stdout.strip().splitlines()[i].strip().split()) and sum(int(p) for p in stdout.strip().splitlines()[i].strip().split()) == int(input_lines[i].strip()))) for i in range(len(input_lines)))
postconditions.description: For each input number (except '0'), the corresponding output line is either '0 0 0' or three primes P1, P2, P3 such that P1 + P2² + P3³ equals the input number.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.strip().splitlines()[i].strip() == '0 0 0' or (int(p1) + int(p2)**2 + int(p3)**3 == int(input_lines[i].strip()) for p1, p2, p3 in [stdout.strip().splitlines()[i].strip().split()])) for i in range(len(input_lines)))
postconditions.description: If the output line is not '0 0 0', the three primes satisfy the equation P1 + P2² + P3³ = input number.
